canon.fragment_is_lens_shard.statement: The fragment is an unbroken shard of the great lens, not dust. It is warm and can't be scratched.

canon.fragments_sing.statement: Carried through a lane current, a fragment sings in tune with the lane lamps.

canon.glass_drift_lens.statement: The Glass Drift is the wreck of one great lens. Glassite is its dust.

canon.lane_lanterns.statement: The lamps along the lanes are Lantern-maker work. The Lamplighter Society was founded to keep them lit, and doesn't know how they work.

canon.lantern_makers.statement: Long before the Reach was settled, a people the Lamplighters call the Lantern-makers built the lane currents. Nobody knows what they looked like.

canon.lens_purpose.statement: What the great lens was for.

canon.no_fragment_trade.statement: The Society never buys or sells fragments. It keeps them, or returns them to whoever found them.

canon.no_living_ancients.statement: Any claim that a Lantern-maker is alive or present in the Reach, or that an Ancients object grants power over ships, minds or prices.

canon.second_fragment.statement: The fragment's song is loudest when facing Brassmouth Narrows. (A direction only, never a location.)

progress.last: At Kettle Dock, a tender joined you.

beat.b01_undock.goal: Ilse needs ice for Odo's greenhouse at Kettle Dock. Fly off with W, turn with A and D, and look for the pale rocks.

beat.b02_mine_by_hand.goal: Ilse wants a full hold of ice: hold Space beside a pale rock until your hold is full.

beat.b03_first_delivery.goal: Ilse asks you to take the ice to Odo at Kettle Dock. Dock in its ring and pick Deliver.

beat.b04_first_sale.goal: Orrin, the Wharf's hullwright, can fit a mining lens for 600 credits. Sell what you mine to pay for it.

beat.b06_nav_chip.goal: Orrin can fit a nav chip at the Wharf: click a point near your ship, the Wren, and she flies there.

beat.b07_cinder_drift.goal: Carry Ilse's 20 plate to Rook at Cinder Hook and pick Deliver. The lane to Cinder Drift starts east of the Wharf.

beat.b08_chasing_a_gap.goal: Rook says Brassmouth Exchange pays well for glassite. Sell 30 there, over 2 separate visits.

beat.b09_hook_dispute.goal: Rook says the Wharf Cooperative and the Tollway Compact both want his ore depot. Supply it in whose name you like, or not at all.

beat.b10_rumor.goal: Pip heard of a fat glassite vein at the Ember Shoals, out on Cinder Drift's far edge.

beat.b11_orders.goal: Orrin says: save a loop between two stations you trust, and let it run twice.

beat.b12_ice_shortage.goal: Odo says Rimewater is thin and Kettle Dock is short of ice. He has two ideas.

beat.b13_first_tender.goal: Tamsin says: give Thimble, your tender, one of your loops and a floor price.

beat.b14_pilot_changes.goal: Orrin says you fly differently these days. Ask him what he means.

cap.click_dock.name: Click to dock
cap.click_dock.summary: Click a station: fly into the ring and dock.

cap.click_fly.name: Click to fly
cap.click_fly.summary: Left-click a point within {click_fly_range} u of the ship: it flies there and stops. Any W, A, S or D press cancels.

cap.click_mine.name: Click to mine
cap.click_mine.summary: Click a rock: fly into reach and mine until the hold is full or the rock is spent.

cap.loops.name: Loops
cap.loops.summary: Save the current queue as a named loop of up to {loop_limit} orders (up to {saved_loop_limit} loops). It repeats until stopped or it stalls.

cap.map_travel.name: Map travel
cap.map_travel.summary: Click a station, field or lane mouth on the map: the ship routes there, entering lanes on its own.

cap.queues.name: Queues
cap.queues.summary: Shift-click appends orders, up to {queue_limit}. Any order can be removed; a sell can take a floor.

ranks.name: Far-sighted

regard.name: Cold
regard.shows: They use your hull's name, not yours. Lines are short. No tips, no rumors.

regard.name: Known
regard.shows: They use your name, mention one of your deeds, and share a price they heard.

regard.name: Trusted
regard.shows: Warm: they ask after your tender or hull, and tell you rumors first.

regard.name: Kin
regard.shows: "One of ours." Their stations hang your name plate on the ring.

tiers.name: Hands on
tiers.summary: A and D turn. W thrusts, S thrusts backward, Shift boosts. Let go and the ship coasts to a stop. Space docks in a ring, rides a lane current from its mouth, mines beside a rock (hold it), and brakes anywhere else. P pauses. M shows the map.

tiers.name: First automation

line.speaker: npc.juno_brask
line.text: See Magpie's course? A lamp first, then a hold of ore. Come back next visit and I'll show you.

line.speaker: npc.juno_brask
line.text: Glassite rocks glint when they go. Did you see it?

line.speaker: npc.pip_calloway
line.text: You're through that lane more often than the barges are.

line.speaker: npc.hesper_lune
line.text: The lane lamps know your hull now. They brighten a little when you pass.

line.speaker: npc.pip_calloway
line.text: You're through that lane more often than the barges are.

line.speaker: npc.rook_adeyemi
line.text: The side you backed holds my depot now, and they left 300 credits with me for you.

line.speaker: npc.juno_brask
line.text: A lamp marks a rock for your loops. Shall I show you how?

line.speaker: npc.juno_brask
line.text: Juno teaches rock lamps at Cinder Hook.

line.speaker: npc.juno_brask
line.text: Press T beside a rock to tend its lamp. Six lamps fit the kit; your tagged field orders choose the richest lit rock.
